scientific_question: Can P1 GPU in-place creation or P3 offline-sidecar acquisition obtain the exact frozen EXEC148 image at lower runtime acquisition cost than the proven P0 CPU-direct reference, thereby expanding the reuse-horizon region in which B dominates the default A primitive?

shared_experiment_contract.correctness_primary: Full canonical tuple-family SHA256 must equal 60565f9f0b12de4884e884d8311263df7238679745c83393a695935cd3eccbb2.
shared_experiment_contract.correctness_secondary: Frozen component oracle remains max_abs <= 0.02 and RMSE <= 0.005; correctness timing is not part of acquisition timing.
shared_experiment_contract.timing_boundary: Measure only runtime acquisition of an already-defined final EXEC148 image. Buffer allocation, model load, pipeline creation, scientific tuple validation, and component correctness validation are outside the primary acquisition timer and reported separately where applicable.

P1.hypothesis: A GPU materializer can produce the exact canonical EXEC148 image directly in the final GPU-accessible UMA buffer with acquisition wall time below the frozen P0 CPU-direct reference.
exact_data_path: Source Q4_K tensors are already resident and GPU-readable.
Final 549,527,552-byte EXEC148 Vulkan storage buffer is allocated before timing.
GPU transformation processes the 3,713,024 independent blocks and writes canonical EXEC148 bytes directly to final buffer.
Required queue completion and visibility barrier complete before acquisition timer stops.
No full-image CPU staging copy is allowed in the primary P1 path.
P1.primary_endpoint: Median serialized ACQUISITION_WALL_MS across 8 independent attempts.
secondary_endpoints: Derived W-S and W-C A-vs-B crossover horizons from frozen A/B latencies.
Creator GPU device time may be reported diagnostically but cannot replace wall time.
Independent scientific validation wall time is reported separately and excluded from architecture acquisition cost.

pass_and_kill_rules.correctness_gate: All 8 images must match the canonical family hash and component correctness oracle.
pass_and_kill_rules.keep_P1: correctness PASS AND median acquisition wall < 231.6382 ms
pass_and_kill_rules.strict_architecture_meaning: P1 then strictly expands B's runtime acquisition region versus P0 because steady-state B and active residency are frozen equal.
pass_and_kill_rules.kill_current_serialized_P1: correctness FAIL OR median acquisition wall >= 231.6382 ms
pass_and_kill_rules.no_rescue: A failed serialized P1 may not be rescued post hoc by overlap, altered EXEC148 semantics, different work decomposition, or different target tensors. Any overlap study is a new prospective lifecycle study.

P3.hypothesis: A versioned pre-materialized EXEC148 sidecar can reduce runtime acquisition cost below P0 in at least one explicitly controlled cache/storage state while preserving exact canonical bytes.

sidecar_contract.payload_semantics: Exact concatenated EXEC148 layer images in frozen layer order; no compression or alternate representation in B1.2.
sidecar_contract.offline_creation_timing: Not a runtime performance endpoint. Sidecar creation happens outside inference runtime and is only correctness-qualified.

WARM_PAGE_CACHE.definition: Before each measured attempt, perform an untimed complete preload of the exact sidecar so its file data is eligible to be resident in the OS page cache; then measure the fixed buffered load path into the already-allocated final mapped Vulkan buffer.
WARM_PAGE_CACHE.interpretation: Measures warm/cached sidecar acquisition, not cold storage.

COLD_UNBUFFERED.definition: Measure a cache-bypassing sequential file-read path using an execution-lock-frozen Windows unbuffered-I/O contract. Any required aligned staging and copy into the final mapped Vulkan buffer are included in acquisition wall time.
COLD_UNBUFFERED.qualification_requirement: Exact unbuffered flags, alignment, chunking and staging/copy path must be frozen and zero-science qualified before performance execution; otherwise COLD_UNBUFFERED remains unauthorized.
COLD_UNBUFFERED.interpretation: Measures the frozen explicit cold path only; it is not a universal SSD benchmark.

P3.shared_timing_anchor: Start immediately before the first runtime sidecar read/copy action and stop only when all payload bytes are present and visible in the final EXEC148 execution buffer. File generation and scientific full-image validation are excluded.
secondary_endpoints: Derived W-S and W-C A-vs-B crossover horizons per cache state.
Peak temporary/staging bytes required by the frozen load path.
Scientific validation wall time reported separately.

pass_and_kill_rules.correctness_gate: Sidecar payload and all 8 loaded final images per state must match the canonical family hash and component correctness oracle.
pass_and_kill_rules.warm_keep: WARM correctness PASS AND warm median acquisition < 231.6382 ms
pass_and_kill_rules.cold_keep: COLD correctness PASS AND cold median acquisition < 231.6382 ms
pass_and_kill_rules.warm_pass_cold_fail_policy: P3 remains a warm-cache placement only; cold-start policy falls back to P0 or A.
pass_and_kill_rules.both_fail: If both warm and cold median acquisition are >= 231.6382 ms, P3 is dominated by P0 for runtime performance under B1 assumptions and is killed for current B1.
pass_and_kill_rules.no_rescue: Do not change sidecar compression, representation, cache definition, I/O mode or EXEC148 semantics after timing is visible.

implementation_parameters_to_freeze_befo: any staging allocation and copy path

cross_candidate_rule.rule: P1 and P3 are adjudicated independently against P0. Only after both frozen results exist may ArcLLM choose the lower valid acquisition cost for a given runtime state.
cross_candidate_rule.B_already_resident: If a valid EXEC148 image is already resident, acquisition cost is zero and placement-creation choice is bypassed.
cross_candidate_rule.memory_pressure: B1.2 does not change the 549,527,552-byte active residency. Eviction under memory pressure falls back to A and is not a failure of P1/P3 acquisition.

forbidden: steady-state B performance retest as a primary endpoint
